mapper.sql: SELECT n.notification_id, n.user_id, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.from_user_id, n.is_read, n.create_time, CASE WHEN n.type IN ('1', '2') AND c.is_anonymous = '1' THEN '匿名用户' WHEN n.type IN ('1', '2') AND c.is_anonymous = '0' THEN n.from_nick_name WHEN n.type IN ('3','4','5') THEN n.from_nick_name ELSE '' END AS from_nick_name, CASE WHEN n.type IN ('1', '2') AND c.is_anonymous = '1' THEN '' WHEN n.type IN ('3','4','5') THEN n.from_avatar ELSE COALESCE(n.from_avatar, '') END AS from_avatar, CASE WHEN n.type IN ('1', '2') THEN COALESCE(c.is_anonymous, '0') ELSE '0' END AS is_anonymous FROM bbs_notification n LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT c1.is_anonymous FROM bbs_comment c1 WHERE c1.del_flag = '0' AND c1.post_id = n.target_id AND c1.user_id = n.from_user_id AND c1.create_time >= n.create_time - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND c1.create_time <= n.create_time + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE ORDER BY ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c1.create_time, n.create_time)) ASC LIMIT 1 ) c ON n.type IN ('1', '2') AND n.target_type = '1'
mapper.insert: insert into bbs_notification (user_id, type, title, content, target_type, target_id, from_user_id, is_read, create_time, from_nick_name, from_avatar) values (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{fromUserId}, '0', sysdate(), #{fromNickName}, #{fromAvatar})
